lede: Paid PHP work first. Homelab and freelance are where SRE and Terraform live. No vault or family systems.

items.name: Indawo (client, via Overdrive)
items.role: Production PHP · site and server ownership
items.stack: PHP, Laravel / legacy PHP, MySQL, Docker, Azure VM, PR deploys
items.blurb: I own this client: spec, cost, plan, build, review until they are happy. I manage the server OS and the application, not Azure hardware. Weekend hardware-loss restore with Docker on CentOS is the production incident that started Docker in anger.

items.name: SAWIS BI (client, via Overdrive)
items.blurb: Wine-industry BI. I own application work and the database path when a job fails. I do not own pipelines, servers, or infrastructure. Full support for the site, not 24/7 call.

items.name: tf-fleet-iac (Siyabonwa)
items.role: Freelance with a friend · Terraform + PHP fleet
items.stack: Terraform, EC2, RDS MySQL 8.4, CodePipeline, CCS
items.blurb: Production truck-management app on AWS I defined in Terraform (af-south-1). Live at fleet.wiums.co.za. This is the public IaC evidence; it is not how Overdrive runs Indawo.

items.name: Homelab streaming SRE
items.blurb: I run a streaming service and treat it as SRE: keep it up, containers, Linux. Private network only — not a public product. Two years of k3s/k3d: stand up, break, fix, run a workload. This is the Kubernetes I have, not a cluster at work.

items.name: This site (ettiene-wium.com)
items.blurb: HTTPS profile. JSON content, authenticated editor, PDF/DOCX. Evidence I can ship a small static production site, not the PHP headline.
